title: 男の子のポップ素材
subject_en: Cool stylish original boy characters in a bold pop illustration style with strong dark outlines and saturated colours, each ONE character full body or waist up, centred, confident poses. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: スケボー・バンド・ヒーロー風など、男の子のキャラクター素材12点です。アイコンやポスター、SNS画像に使えます。
